signature_moves: Periwinkle-violet lowercase field-label system (~#8A80E0) across all detail fields — brand-owned, non-native, and the single most recognizable 1Password design decision
Faithful macOS selection-duality in Electron: soft inset source-list fill in the sidebar vs solid-accent white-text focused-table fill in the content list, honouring first-responder focus
Brand-warm consumer chrome over a security tool: coloured per-item favicons, yellow-star favorite glyph, friendly account-switcher — approachability engineered into a password manager
defects: Non-native tracked-uppercase headers — CATEGORIES/VAULTS + A-Z index letters tracked uppercase; HIG sidebars.md/lists-and-tables.md explicit 'common non-native mistake' (native = system-font semibold secondary sentence-case)
Contrast Dilution (partial) — violet field labels ~2.8:1 and gray subtitles ~3.5-4:1 dip under WCAG 4.5:1; de-emphasis achieved by dropping a brand hue below the contrast floor
iOS-style inset-grouped field card — credential fields wrapped in a rounded hairline-separated card rather than flat labels on one opaque surface (UIKit/web-derived)
Electron density tell — body ~14-15px, one size looser than native 13pt Body

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (Linear/Vercel family) rendered in a LIGHT neutral ramp and softened by consumer brand colour (violet labels, blue accent) — a friendly cross-platform utility remix, not the dark electric-accent variant

psychology: Jakob's Law — exploited well: mimics the Mail/Finder three-pane + real macOS chrome so users arrive already knowing how to navigate; familiarity lowers the learning cost of a security tool
Von Restorff / signal-detection — the single saturated accent selection is the one loud element on an otherwise de-emphasized field, so the current item is unmissable
Recognition over recall — per-item brand favicons + A-Z jump index let users locate credentials visually/positionally instead of reading every name
Aesthetic-usability effect (processing fluency) — polished native-feeling chrome raises perceived trustworthiness, which compounds for a product whose entire value is trust
Miller/Cowan chunking — sidebar navigation chunked into pinned rows / Categories / Vaults / Archive, keeping each level within working-memory span
notes: Only a marketing COVER composite was supplied (no shot-*.* files; gallery empty). App window is genuine UI on the right ~560px, cropped; left half is brand backdrop (icy-mint->periwinkle gradient, navy wordmark) analysed separately. All values (estimated) from a ~1x JPEG render — colours JPEG-shifted, no retina precision. Lineage web-electron is BOTH publicly known (1Password 8 = Electron + Rust core) and unambiguous from tells; therefore contrast evidence only, excluded from macOS canon — seed it into a non-native tells-and-corrections cluster, never TASTE.md canon. era='big-sur' denotes the native visual era it EMULATES (rounded Big Sur->Sonoma chrome), not native Big Sur evidence; it is effectively custom Electron-drawn. Impressive counter-example: an Electron app that gets selection-duality, traffic-light focus states, capsule search and borderless toolbar symbols right — its tells are narrowed to three (uppercase headers, violet labels, inset-grouped cards). No dark-mode, settings, empty-state, onboarding, or sheet surfaces available. Icon (icon.webp) present but Workflow B not run per task scope.
